notes.title: ⛈️ Cloudscrapers x Games Forged in Germany ⛅
notes.content:
Steam Event: Games Forged in Germany


The Games Forged in Germany Steam Event is live from July 24-31 and Cloudscrapers is featured among the upcoming releases! 🎉



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562200/Cloudscrapers/"][/dynamiclink]

While we don’t have a demo yet and visibility is still growing, we’d love for you to check out our game’s page, wishlist Cloudscrapers, and follow us if you like what you see. Every bit of support helps a small indie team like ours, and sharing the game with others makes a big difference!

notes.title: ☁️ Playtest #1 is coming – Register now! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey, Cloudscraper! ☁️🛠️
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530066/36ee6017b270a99907ea73513002ec8c9ca4bab9.png"]

We’re excited to announce that Cloudscrapers is nearly ready for its very first closed playtest – and you’re invited to take part in it! This is your chance to play an early version of the game and help us improve it with your feedback ✨



Registrations are NOW OPEN and will remain available for a couple of weeks. From these we’ll select a first group of testers – if you’d like to be considered, please sign-up to our newsletter to get the playtest invite:


👉 cloudscrapersgame.com


Keep in mind: Cloudscrapers is still in active development. The version you’ll be playing is early, imperfect, and still evolving, but your input at this stage will be incredibly valuable.

Participation also requires joining our Discord server. That’s where we’ll coordinate everything and gather feedback.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530066/938df26a26b44e40c7db176ad1e85bf8b4c26615.png"]

We hope you're as excited to play the game as we are to share it with you! 🤍



☁️ See you in the clouds ☁️

The Cloudscrapers Team

notes.title: 🎮 Be the first to play!
notes.content:

The development of Cloudscrapers is picking up pace, and we're working hard to bring you the best possible demo as the next big step. In the meantime, we’d love your help: Over the coming months, we’ll be running several pre-release playtests to gather feedback and keep making the game even better.

By joining our newsletter, you'll get access to these playtests – along with exclusive digital goodies every now and then. Thank you for your support! 🤍

👉 cloudscrapersgame.com
